 IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/CRIMINAL MISC.APPLICATION (FOR QUASHING & SET ASIDE  FIR/ORDER) NO. 32887 of 2016  ==========================================================
 ROHANBHAI HITENDRABHAI (JITUBHAI) PATEL  Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT & ANR.
 ==========================================================
 Appearance:
 MR HARDIK H DAVE(6295) for the Applicant(s) No. 1  NOTICE SERVED for the Respondent(s) No. 2  MR CHINTAN DAVE, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE J. C. DOSHI  Date : 09/06/2025  ORAL ORDER 1.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By way of this application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the applicant has prayed to quash and set aside the FIR being C.R.No.I-118 of 2016 registered with Navapura Police Station for the offences under Sections 406 and 420 of Indian Penal Code and all the consequential proceedings arising therefrom qua the present applicant.
2. Learned advocate Mr.Parth Parekh submits that he has instructions to appear for respondent no.2.
He is permitted to file Vakalatnama.
He has produced affidavit of respondent no.2, which is taken on record.
The original complainant is present before the Court and is identified by his learned advocate.

3. Both the parties to the proceedings, submit that the matter is settled between the parties and in support thereof, the respondent No.2 - original complainant has filed affidavit.

sentences.text: NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/32887/2016 ORDER DATED: 09/06/2025 undefined 4.

In the affidavit, respondent no.2 in para 3 and 4 has stated as under :-
"3.

It is submitted that with the intervention of some trusted persons of the society,
the matter has been resolved between us and the present applicant.
It is further submitted that now no grievance remain between us and the present applicant.
In view of above backdrop, I do not want to pursue the above criminal case.

Therefore,
continuation of the criminal proceedings against the present applicant would not serve any fruitful purpose.

4. It is submitted that since the dispute in question is resolved between us and the present applicant, so I have no objection if this Hon'ble Court quash the FIR being I.C.R.No.118 of 2016 registered on 01.12.2016 before the Navapura Police Station,
District Vadodara and all prior and subsequent proceedings in the interest of justice."
5.

Learned advocates for the respective parties submitted that during the pendency of proceedings,
the parties have settled the dispute amicably and pursuant to such mutual settlement, the original complainant has also filed an Affidavit, which is on record.

In the Affidavit, the original complainant has categorically stated that the dispute with the applicant has been resolved amicably and that she has no objection, if the present proceedings are quashed and set aside since there is no surviving grievance between them.

6. In view of above, in the opinion of this Court, further continuation of criminal proceedings against the applicant in relation to the impugned FIR would cause unnecessary harassment to the applicant.

Hence, to secure the ends of justice, it would be appropriate to quash and set aside the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/32887/2016 ORDER DATED: 09/06/2025 undefined impugned FIR and all consequential proceedings initiated in pursuance thereof under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C..
7.
In the result, the application is allowed.

The impugned complaint being FIR being C.R.No.I-118 of 2016 registered with Navapura Police Station as well as all consequential proceedings initiated in pursuance thereof are hereby quashed and set aside qua the applicant herein.
Direct service is permitted.

(J. C. DOSHI,J) SATISH Rohanbhai Hitendrabhai (Jitubhai) ... vs State Of Gujarat on 9 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156871037/
